subject.title: fix(gateway): require shared secret for tailscale serve auth

question: When `gateway.auth.requireTailscaleSharedSecret` is enabled, must every applicable Control UI WebSocket connection—including reconnects with an issued device token—present both verified Tailscale identity and the configured token/password?
rationale: The answer determines whether the current device-token behavior is a security bypass or an intentional post-bootstrap credential contract; code and naming cannot safely choose that policy without owner approval.

options.title: Enforce both every time
options.body: Require verified Tailscale identity plus token/password on every applicable connection and prevent device-token or disabled-Tailscale paths from weakening the boundary.

options.title: Make it bootstrap-only
options.body: Allow device-token reconnects after one layered login, but rename and document the setting so it does not promise both factors on every request.

options.title: Pause the new setting
options.body: Keep the existing tokenless Tailscale behavior and defer a new security/config contract until the intended device and reconnect semantics are designed.

recommendation.title: Enforce both every time
recommendation.body: Require verified Tailscale identity plus token/password on every applicable connection and prevent device-token or disabled-Tailscale paths from weakening the boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest recent history signal spans Gateway auth, WebSocket connection handling, and session behavior where this policy must be owned.
